title: AlchLang Three-Vertical Compilation Campaign
objective: Produce three semantically distinct, end-to-end reference examples that begin as reviewed AlchLang governed-domain descriptions, cross every applicable CAV2-D65 predecessor, compile deterministically through DomainSpec v2, bind to exact TypeScript reference implementations, and finish with independent conformance evidence.
implemented_definition: For this campaign, implemented means an exact buildable reference implementation exercises generated validators, state transitions, event contracts, bounded action adapters, and tests against frozen inputs. It does not mean admitted, released, deployed, production-ready, or authorized to cause real external effects.
one_campaign_interpretation: One frozen-input campaign with fail-fast internal gates and three independently provable verticals; not one giant mutation and not permission to skip semantic adoption, compilation determinism, binding, security, or conformance gates.

current_d65_position.canonical_definitions: validated references plus candidate local terms
current_d65_position.first_blocking_gate: Exact owner adoption of the AlchLang Definition Pack, Product Capability, and selected business-ontology bytes.

reference_realization_candidate.posture: campaign proposal requiring a preimplementation decision
reference_realization_candidate.surface: A small CLI plus pure compiler library
constraints: Generated action tools must delegate effects to injected adapters and acquire no ambient authority.
Unknown or unresolved meaning must produce a diagnostic or blocked output, never an invented default.
The same frozen source, profile, compiler, and dependency lock must produce byte-identical generated artifacts in two clean runs.
The TypeScript target is a replaceable reference realization and does not become the AlchLang Product Capability.

shared_compiler_lane.purpose: Define and realize the semantics-preserving lowering from reviewed AlchLang meaning to DomainSpec v2 authored source and from admitted DomainSpec source to deterministic reference outputs.
required_predecessors: an accepted AlchLang Domain Construction Handoff
one exact DomainSpec v2 project, profile, language epoch, and source contract
a separate compiler Product Capability and capability-local business ontology candidate
accepted mappings for every AlchLang term and typed edge used by the three verticals
compiler_obligations: preserve source locations, term IDs, edge IDs, owners, open questions, and authority boundaries
reject dangling terms, untyped edges, unreachable states, invalid transitions, unresolved required questions, and authority collapse
emit a traceability record for every generated type, validator, transition, event, action tool, test, graph node, and graph edge
separate authored DomainSpec source from deterministic compiler output
expose diagnostics without silently repairing business meaning
completion_evidence: golden-output tests for all three verticals
negative and mutation tests for each compiler obligation

verticals.title: Customer credit release
verticals.why_distinct: Exercises lifecycle state, risk classification, permission conditions, human confirmation, and denial before a consequential action.

rules: riskScore <= 472 classifies the customer as high-risk
credit may be released only from approved
minimum_domain_model.authority_case: A high-risk release requires a recorded human confirmation from the named credit authority.

verticals.implementation_slice: Generated TypeScript model, validator, state machine, event contract, ReleaseCredit tool wrapper, and injected in-memory credit adapter.
required_cases: high-risk release without confirmation is denied
unknown risk provenance blocks the affected decision

verticals.title: Inventory reservation
verticals.why_distinct: Exercises numeric invariants, competing reservations, idempotency, event ordering, and compensation without relying on the credit state model.

rules: total active reservations may not exceed available quantity
the same request key may not reserve twice
minimum_domain_model.open_question: Which inventory observation owns the available quantity when concurrent requests race?

verticals.implementation_slice: Generated TypeScript validators and event/state contracts plus a deterministic transactional in-memory reservation adapter with idempotency and compensation.
required_cases: two competing requests preserve the invariant
unresolved observation ownership blocks concurrency claims

verticals.title: Production rollback
verticals.why_distinct: Exercises explicit effect authority, confirmation, revocation, external-effect uncertainty, receipts, and recovery while forbidding a real deployment effect.

rules: rollback requires an active incident and an approved target revision
authority must still be valid immediately before the effect
minimum_domain_model.authority_case: Only the bounded incident commander grant may confirm the simulated effect; revocation fails closed.

verticals.implementation_slice: Generated TypeScript contracts and state machine plus a sandbox-only rollback adapter that can return certain success, certain failure, or uncertain outcome with an evidence receipt.
required_cases: timeout becomes uncertain rather than success
no test can reach a real deployment endpoint

produces: immutable adoption or rejection decisions for exact AlchLang predecessor digests
phases.completion_gate: All selected semantic predecessors are adopted for campaign use or the campaign stops.

produces: compiler capability and business ontology candidates
phases.completion_gate: Every used AlchLang construct has one reviewed mapping or an explicit blocker; the handoff names exact DomainSpec identities.

produces: positive, negative, boundary, and missing-information examples
phases.completion_gate: Each vertical independently closes required terms and typed edges, preserves open questions, and has a bounded owner decision.

requires: accepted DomainSpec project, profile, language epoch, source contract, and compiler identity
phases.completion_gate: Every vertical compiles twice to byte-identical output and every generated element traces to reviewed meaning.
All targets build and their positive, denial, boundary, uncertainty, determinism, and no-ambient-authority tests pass.
Every required rule and boundary has exact realization and evidence, or is explicitly not_evaluable with its blocker.

produces: owner decision envelopes for next use
phases.completion_gate: Owners decide separately whether each vertical is a valid reference example and whether any compiler or language change should be proposed.

campaign_success_conditions: Exactly three semantically distinct verticals complete the same declared D65 chain.
The shared compiler emits byte-identical artifacts for two clean runs of each frozen vertical.
Each reference implementation builds and executes its positive, negative, boundary, missing-information, and authority tests.
The rollback vertical proves sandbox isolation and cannot address a real deployment endpoint.
Independent conformance reports distinguish PASS, FAIL, and not_evaluable without promoting business meaning.
No phase treats successful generation as adoption, authority, conformance, release, or product-value proof.
failure_policy: Fail closed at the first changed or missing selected dependency, unresolved required meaning, rejected owner decision, untyped or dangling edge, non-deterministic output, traceability gap, implementation drift, authority collapse, sandbox escape, ambiguous effect reported as success, or evidence-binding failure. Preserve the failed receipt and do not execute successor phases implicitly.
open_residue: Exact AlchLang Definition Pack, Product Capability, and business-ontology bytes are not adopted.
The parent Language Project has concurrent user changes and does not index this owner-local candidate plan.
No AlchLang source grammar or carrier has been accepted.
No exact DomainSpec project, profile, language epoch, source contract, compiler identity, or construction handoff has been accepted.
The TypeScript CLI and compiler library are campaign proposals, not selected implementation bindings.
No implementation or independent conformance authority has been granted.
claim_ceiling: Private owner-local planning candidate for one shared compiler lane and three end-to-end reference verticals. It does not adopt AlchLang meaning, admit an ontology or DomainSpec profile, create DomainSpec source, generate a system ontology, select or implement a compiler, register a ConstructionBinding, prove conformance or product value, publish, release, deploy, or authorize an external effect.
